description: Renegotiate the bounded hauling promise from Mara's current rupture/custody state rather than treating old biography as a permanent boundary.

replacements.old:
(<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-BIO-BROKE-PROMISE>
                  <R1277-PUT ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE 0>
                  <R1277-HOUSE-PUT ,R1277-HS-PROMISE-NOTED 0>
                  <TELL "Mara faces the promised " D .OBJ " without pretending the relationship state stayed the same. I made that commitment before the rupture. I am releasing this optional hauling promise explicitly rather than letting it disappear in silence." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)
replacements.new:
(<MARA-RUPTURE-OPEN?>
                  <R1277-PUT ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE 0>
                  <R1277-HOUSE-PUT ,R1277-HS-PROMISE-NOTED 0>
                  <TELL "Mara faces the promised " D .OBJ " without pretending the relationship state stayed the same. I made that commitment before the rupture, she says. The current boundary is distance. I am releasing this optional hauling promise explicitly rather than letting it disappear in silence." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)
                 (<AND <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-BIO-BROKE-PROMISE>
                       <ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-BIO-ROPE-RETURNED>>>
                  <R1277-PUT ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE 0>
                  <R1277-HOUSE-PUT ,R1277-HS-PROMISE-NOTED 0>
                  <TELL "Mara looks from the promised " D .OBJ " to the still-unresolved rope custody. I cannot honestly keep an optional close-labor promise stacked on top of an entrusted thing you have not returned, she says. Settle the real custody first; this promise is released, not forgotten." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)
